options.name: Progression Balancing
options.doc:
A system that can move progression earlier, to try and prevent the player from getting stuck and bored early.

A lower setting means more getting stuck. A higher setting means less getting stuck.
options.doc_html:
A system that can move progression earlier, to try and prevent the player from getting stuck and bored early.

A lower setting means more getting stuck. A higher setting means less getting stuck.
options.doc_fr:
Un système qui peut déplacer la progression plus tôt, pour essayer et empêcher le joueur de se coincer et s'ennuyer tôt.

Un réglage plus bas signifie qu'il reste coincé. Un réglage plus élevé signifie moins se coincer.

options.name: Accessibility
options.doc:
Set rules for reachability of your items/locations.

**Full:** ensure everything can be reached and acquired.

**Minimal:** ensure what is needed to reach your goal can be acquired.
options.doc_html:
Set rules for reachability of your items/locations.

Full: ensure everything can be reached and acquired.

Minimal: ensure what is needed to reach your goal can be acquired.
options.doc_fr:
Définir les règles d'accessibilité de vos objets/emplacements.

**Full:** s'assurer que tout peut être atteint et acquis.

**Minimal:** s'assurer que ce qui est nécessaire pour atteindre votre objectif peut être acquis.
options.doc_html_fr:
Définir les règles d'accessibilité de vos objets/emplacements.

Minimal: s'assurer que ce qui est nécessaire pour atteindre votre objectif peut être acquis.

options.name: Pickupsanity
options.doc: Whether collecting freestanding 1ups, HP and Weapon Energy capsules will grant a check.

options.name: Character
options.doc:
Choose which character you'd like to play as during your seed
NOTE: If Zero, certain locations are excluded to prevent unbeatable seeds.
options.doc_fr: Choisissez le personnage que vous souhaitez jouer comme pendant votre graine NOTE : Si Zero, certains emplacements sont exclus pour empêcher les graines imbattables.

options.name: Death Link
options.doc: When you die, everyone who enabled death link dies. Of course, the reverse is true too.
options.doc_html: When you die, everyone who enabled death link dies. Of course, the reverse is true too.
options.doc_fr: Quand vous mourez, tous ceux qui ont permis la mort meurent. Bien sûr, l'inverse est vrai aussi.
options.doc_html_fr: Quand vous mourez, tous ceux qui ont permis la mort meurent. Bien sûr, l'inverse est vrai aussi.

options.name: Damage Link
options.doc: Share damage with other players through DamageLink.

options.name: Energy Link
options.doc: Enable EnergyLink support. When enabled, the client can spend EnergyLink to restore current HP.

options.name: DeathLink Amnesty
options.doc:
Number of lives to restore after sending or receiving a DeathLink.
This prevents DeathLink from immediately causing repeated game overs.
Receiving the EX Tank will increase this by 2.

options.name: Energy Link Auto Heal
options.doc: Automatically spend EnergyLink to heal missing HP during gameplay.
options.doc_fr: Passer automatiquement EnergyLink pour guérir les HP manquants pendant le gameplay.

options.name: Energy Link Cost Per HP
options.doc: EnergyLink cost for each HP point restored by auto heal.

options.name: Infinite Nova Strike
options.doc:
Lock Nova Strike / Giga Attack energy to full while in-game.
This writes 0x30 to the Nova Strike energy RAM value every client tick.
